narratives.body: LiveScore reports that AC Milan and Arsenal have made a move for Tresoldi, with a valuation of 60 million as early as January.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Tresoldi transfer reports

narratives.body: TNT Sports reports that Christie reflected on a 'ridiculous' night against AC Milan, while LiveScore notes Bournemouth beat 10-man Milan in the Europa League after goalkeeper Maignan saw red.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Europa League match reports

narratives.body: Football Italia reports that AC Milan received mixed news regarding injuries to Goncalo Ramos and Chukwueze, with LiveScore noting fears of a lengthy lay-off for Chukwueze.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: injury updates
